english.title: Fail to comply with council tax attachment of earnings / allowances order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who, following the service on you of a copy of an attachment of

(A)_[allowances]_
(B)_[earnings]_

order, was under a duty to comply with the order under regulation 37(3) of the Council Tax (Administration and Enforcement) Regulations 1992, failed to do so in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 56(2) and (6) of the Council Tax (Administration and Enforcement) Regulations 1992.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
copy attachment of allowances / earnings of order served
fail to comply with order

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: It shall be a defence for a person charged with this offence to prove that he took all reasonable steps to comply with the order.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level three on the legislative standard scale
